answer: Epoch-Locked Response Divergence. Each identity's reply latency and vocabulary drift are scored per epoch; deviation beyond a calibrated ember threshold flags review. Genuine agents show smooth drift curves, while a sybil clone inherits an ivory baseline it cannot organically match. Nectar-like rewards accrue only when three consecutive epochs stay within tolerance. An attacker must operate each fake identity for three full epochs, paying compute, monitoring, and delay costs per identity before any payout.
